name: Kinesis Silver
oneLiner: KAG is Kinesis Silver, a tokenized claim on one troy ounce of investment-grade silver bullion with direct physical redemption and transaction-fee yield sharing.
collateral: Investment-grade physical silver bullion (1 KAG = 1 troy ounce)
pegMechanism: KMS Labs' ERC-20 KAG is backed 1:1 by Kinesis-native KAG after compliance onboarding; native KAG is then redeemable for allocated physical silver through Kinesis Cayman. ERC-20 balances do not accrue Kinesis transaction-fee yield.

mintAuthority.summary: KAG is a Fireblocks ERC20F UUPS token on Ethereum; minting requires a role granted through the AccessRegistry. The token's admin EOAs (0xe560c473 x2, 0x3e96eb2e) are confirmed Fireblocks MPC/HSM EOAs — no on-chain code. Upgrade authority is embedded in the UUPS impl and gated by the same roles. Issuer-backend minting model fully corroborated on-chain.

Implementation = 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62 (ERC20F by Fireblocks). Constructor args decoded show admin addresses 0xe560c473dee7b1d1d5ae316f4c1cba7157de498e (x2) and 0x3e96eb2e94485712d0970c471d31ac3d8054b493 — all confirmed EOAs (eth_getCode returns 0x). owner() and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE direct calls revert (no standard Ownable; access via AccessRegistrySubscription).
